Respects X-Robots-Tag HTTP header directives

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'respect_robots_txt' => true }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.x_robots_tag.inspect
puts result.noindex_detected.inspect
puts result.nofollow_detected.inspect
```
